properties.name: Who is working is a property of the session, not of the server process
properties.statement: Seat identity is currently minted once per process, which is correct while one session owns one server and wrong the moment several sessions share one. A hosted server would report the same seat for every client, so every claim would carry the same owner and claim_report's liveness would answer a question nobody asked — the mechanism would look like it worked while telling all six sessions they are each other. The seat must come from the client: the transport already assigns a session id with zero coordination, which is exactly what dec:identity-out-of-band says a name should be. The read-side loop_hint's fire-on-change throttle has the same shape of bug — it is per-service state, so a hint earned by one session lands on whichever session reads next.
